reason: I run a growing business and I like studios that show real work. This carousel is a demo of a scam-check chat marked as a concept, not a live product, and it never says what the agent service costs, what it does for my bookings or sales, or who has used it. I would save it and maybe comment for the task map, but I would not pay this week.
objection: Will better design actually bring more customers? The post shows a clever WhatsApp demo but no proof that an agent on my messages would bring in a single extra client.
would_change_my_mind: A live, priced agent I can try on my own enquiries for a few weeks, with a named business that shows the numbers before and after.
